title: Dance Of The Clairvoyants
original_lyrics:
[verse]
Primeira Parte

[chorus]
To commotion
What love is
To our devotion
Imperceptibly big
As big as the ocean
And equally hard to control
So save your predictions
And burn your assumptions
Love is friction
Ripe for comfort
Endless equations
And tugging persuasions
Doors open up
To interpretation
Expecting perfection
Leaves lot to ignore
When the past is the present
And the future's no more
When every tomorrow
Is the same as before
( )
Segunda Parte
The looser things get
The tighter you become
The looser things get
Tighter
Not one man can be
Greater than the sun
It's not negative thought

[bridge]
Falling down, not staying down

[chorus]
Rather than tearing me down
Expecting perfection
Leaves lot to ignore

When every tomorrow
